dropped.item: Description of the Land Rover as 'a welcome addition to the team and a reminder of what your support makes possible'

changed.item: Land Rover arrival certainty: 'is due to arrive in November' (expected) became 'arrives in November' (stated as definite)
'your generosity helps us be there' became 'it's your support that keeps us ready to go', which makes supporters sound like the sole cause rather than a contributing one
'Thanks to your donations, our new Land Rover...' became 'Your donations have also bought us a new Land Rover', which states more explicitly that donations fully paid for the purchase

added.item: 'have a look around' as an open-day activity
'We can't wait to see it.' (enthusiasm about the Land Rover)
'just' in 'just cheered us on', which slightly downplays that form of support
